Autoresearch goal: ARIA-NBV Python standards and aria_nbv package guidance source-of-truth audit

Research methodology / professor-critic rubric:
Pass only if the research identifies all current Python/package guidance owners and redundancies, uses litkg or the repo KG where available to find additional candidate sources, compares against current external best-practice sources, explains why agents still reimplement existing aria_nbv functionality or violate Python standards, and produces a ranked streamlining plan with deprecation candidates, owner surfaces, verification gates, and residual risks.

Completion gate: record a passing professor-critic verdict with omx autoresearch-goal verdict --slug aria-nbv-python-standards-and-aria-nbv-package-g --verdict pass --evidence "<critic artifact/evidence>". After the objective audit passes, call update_goal({status: "complete"}), call get_goal again, then run omx autoresearch-goal complete --slug aria-nbv-python-standards-and-aria-nbv-package-g --codex-goal-json "<fresh get_goal JSON or path>".
